title: Oscar and the Monsoon
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Dominic Underhill, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
